Alex is building Tidepool, an internal alerting service at Northwind Labs that flags data-quality
anomalies in the nightly pipelines, together with Sam Brennan. Tidepool's target is to ship
real-time alerting by March 2027. It is a prototype for now and runs on Kafka.
